payout_quote: Official Varsity Tutors job listing (jobs.varsitytutors.com): 'Base contract rates start at $18/hour and increase for specialized subjects. Plus, you'll earn incrementally higher pay for each session with the same student—reaching up to $40/hour.' And: 'Get paid up to twice per week, ensuring fast and reliable compensation for the tutoring sessions you conduct and invoice.'
steps: Apply on the Varsity Tutors jobs board for a tutoring subject/region.
Complete the tutor application, subject screening, and onboarding.
Get matched with students; conduct online tutoring sessions.
Invoice sessions; paid up to twice per week at your contract rate ($18/hr base, up to $40/hr).
catches: The $18/hr is a BASE contract rate — your actual rate depends on subject specialization and repeat sessions with the same student.
Work is contract-based; hours and student volume are not guaranteed.
Pay rises incrementally per session with the same student, so new or one-off students pay at the base rate.
You invoice for conducted sessions; unpaid no-shows/cancellations may reduce earnings.
biggest_catch: The advertised $18-$40/hr is a contract rate range, not a guarantee — you start at the $18/hr base and only reach higher rates through specialized subjects and repeat sessions with the same students, with no guaranteed hours.
eligibility: Subject expertise; pass Varsity Tutors screening and onboarding.
timing: Paid up to twice per week for conducted/invoiced sessions.
